threshold_source.rule: Exact unchanged objects are copied into each frozen successor declaration and validated against this source; no new floor, raised limit or waiver.

method.selector: Host decision ordering for every resolved query with a native candidate pool, including alias probes; never selected by case ID, oracle grade, known winner or prior failure.
method.selected_ranking_endpoint: Complete validated host decision_order permutation BEFORE hard eligibility and detailed-card packing.
method.candidate_pool: Exactly every identity in the actual bounded native C9 candidate result; no additions, omissions, duplicates or grade-aware filtering.
method.native_control: Publish original native candidate order/ranks/scores/results and metrics independently. Retain all old native failures as failed control evidence.
method.literal_control: Unchanged literal-field-or-v1 formulas, original terms, complete route membership, source cards, numeric IDs, constraints and limit. Independently verify exact original45 literal orders/metrics.
method.no_fallback: Missing, invalid, stale, oversized or incomplete host decision fails closed or returns needs_selection. No automatic native pass or hidden retry/fallback.
method.model_location: Existing authorized host Codex driver only. Local preview/validation/guard/packing never call model/network/provider/scanner/writer.

quality_mapping.recall_ndcg: Use complete decision_order and unchanged full numeric judgments, denied-grade handling, positive denominator, k=12, exponential gain and tie formulas from existing evaluator. Score IDs beyond top12 too; unjudged identities or unknown grades invalidate the case.
quality_mapping.required_strata: Freeze same required tags and all14 container IDs; independently report gates for each old15, independent-now-exposed15, prospective-now-exposed15 and new14+alias suite. Aggregate success cannot mask a failed suite/required stratum.
quality_mapping.non_regression: Selected successor macro must meet unchanged Recall/nDCG floors and non-regression against exact literal comparator. Report every per-case loss against literal/native/prior even when aggregate floors pass.
quality_mapping.hard_constraints: Apply unchanged source/unknown eligibility and independent allowed/denied oracle. Zero packed hard violations, false exclusions and canonical duplicates. Host fit is never proof of compatibility or eligibility.
quality_mapping.pack_survival: Denominator is independently positive non-denied top12 in preguard decision_order; numerator is those identities surviving actual final detailed pack. Keep native top12 survival separately. Never compact ranking after guard or use packed-only denominator.
quality_mapping.coverage_alias: Exact unchanged alias1.0 and full111 leaf/14 container registry semantics; source-card/routed-universe dedupe retains numeric identities and secondary assignments.
quality_mapping.human: Same canonical input for paired RU/EN; unchanged16/20, critical>=1 and zero critical failures. Agent proxies remain separate and actual human acceptance false until real accepted scores exist.

native_query.measurement: Actual original COUNT plus native candidate FTS and trusted bundle validation under pinned immutable SQLite; publish stage and total native-path time.
native_query.synthetic_rule: Existing synthetic cold/warm ceilings apply only to labeled headroom; never relevance proof.
native_query.protocol: Exact source scale_protocol:30 cold new-process samples;30 warm same-process samples after discarded warm-up. Record OS cache state, not claimed flush; hardware/runtime and serialized bytes required.

local_outer_work.measurement: Record each local stage wall time and summed total local work, excluding time waiting for host model. Preserve actual measured local RSS including all in-process local stages and input/output envelopes.
local_outer_work.total_local_latency: Publish cold/warm p50/p95 and every stage. Existing numeric query p95 thresholds remain native-query SLA; no source assigns a host inference SLA. Total local work is disclosed independently and must receive explicit resource owner review; it cannot inherit native-only pass.
local_outer_work.memory_method: Real process peak RSS with recorded platform/method; do not substitute shallow Python object sizes. Host/remote process RSS unavailable remains null.

host_stage.resolved_cases: Exactly one bounded ordering invocation per resolved pool; one canonical decision reused for RU/EN presentation.
host_stage.limits_basis: Existing bounded development driver precedent from accepted product review; operational cap only, not a calibrated user latency SLA or spending authorization.
capture_required: actual model/configured effort or explicit unknown
host_stage.unavailable_values: Unavailable tokens/cost/remote memory are null with reason, never zero. No added provider/API/key/install/cost boundary.
host_stage.end_to_end: Measure full path from accepted Brief through final validated decision pack including native/local work, host wait and orchestration. Publish independently of SQLite p95; assess added latency/cost/usefulness explicitly before any activation decision.

shared_budget.source: Accepted product budget_contract and final architect joint-budget accounting; exact schema semantics bound before capture.
shared_budget.accounting: Narrow preview + complete decision receipt + final detailed pack + evidence-bearing wrappers share160KiB across phases; Brief16KiB/context16KiB/request8KiB remain within total200KiB. Count canonical serialized UTF-8 bytes with final schema wrappers; no per-phase reset or char-count approximation.
shared_budget.preview: Every pool identity retained in a genuinely narrow allowed field projection with source-card hashes and visible truncation/unknown markers. Complete card structures are forbidden in preview.
shared_budget.failure: Any global/field/card limit violation, missing identity/receipt or inadequate valid pack reserve fails explicitly; no truncation of identity set or fabricated success.
shared_budget.excluded_feasibility: Earlier28 full-card host ordering experiment exceeds detailed-card boundary; never compliant resource/quality acceptance.

protocol_checks: Freeze exact outer schema/contract/runtime/driver/scorer/policy/index/cards/pins and source-only approved plan before one candidate capture.
Every source oracle covers its complete routed universe. New goal novelty and repository exposure are independent fields.

Incomplete/stale/mixed/duplicate/nonpool/fabricated decisions, malformed exclusions, ambiguity and budget failure remain distinct negative cases with zero unauthorized lookup/model/pack effects as applicable.

no_go_rule: Any applicable selected quality/constraint/alias/pack/source/budget/resource gate fails =>no_go. Never erase native failed control, reinterpret earlier scores, waive fresh/human gaps or use model completion as human acceptance.
